summary: Frontend-only testing of the meeting template section REORDER enhancement. Verified Up/Down move buttons on upcoming[0] and past[0] meetings: (a) boundary buttons disabled (Move Up on top, Move Down on bottom), (b) Move Down on first swaps with second, (c) Move Up on last swaps with penultimate. Save + edit-mode toggle + hard reload + GET /api/content all reflect the new order. Fixed 'Decisions Made' and 'Action Items' fields on past meetings remain present. Regression: add and remove section still work. Native HTML5 drag-and-drop not exercised (harness limitation), but Up/Down buttons are the primary reorder proof. All test data cleaned up (sections=[]).
critical_code_review_comments: MeetingSections in Meetings.jsx is well-structured; disabled state uses idx from sections (not visible) which is correct since edit mode shows all sections.
Drag handlers use onDragOver preventDefault only when dragId is set — this correctly makes the drop target valid in edit mode; native HTML5 DnD not automated but manual usage should work.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily added 3 sections each to meetings.upcoming[0] and meetings.past[0]; cleaned up (sections=[]) at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reorder feature via Up/Down buttons verified end-to-end including backend persistence via /api/content. If asked to verify native HTML5 drag-and-drop, note Playwright's dispatchEvent for dragstart/dragover/drop may be required — button-based reorder is currently the primary UX contract.
